A '''bioagent''' deployed by the [[Lightning Battalion]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] was utilized in the [[Icarii Campaign]] on the planet [[Vestar/Legends|Vestar]]. Upon being aerially deployed, it would dissolve the innards of the hardy [[Icarii]], and essentially wiped the species off the face of the planet.
